structured_output.what_is_happening: CLAV "Looksmaxing" is a coin launched directly on PumpSwap. It is not a pump.fun curve coin: its address has no "pump" suffix and it was created at the same moment as its pool. It references Clavicular (Braden Peters), a looksmaxxing streamer who was charged with rape in Massachusetts on 2026-09-22. At detection the coin was 23 minutes old, had risen about 775%, and had done about $704k of volume against a $105k market cap and $33k of liquidity. The market data looks manufactured. GeckoTerminal counts 2,046 unique buyers but only 36 unique sellers. Unique buyers in the last 5 minutes were only 27, so the buyer count came almost entirely in one early burst, which looks like a bot spray. One unlabeled wallet holds 80.57% of supply, 100% of the LP is unlocked, and GMGN rates 81% of traders as bot or degen. There are several near-identical CLAV "Looksmaxing" clones from the last 25 minutes. One of them (C5bm) shows $0 liquidity after $419k of hourly volume, which looks like a recent rug. This token's description field holds the contract address of another clone (HccK).

narrative.description: A Clavicular / looksmaxxing meme riding his rape charge from 2026-09-22, which was widely covered. The story is real but four days old, and the topic (sexual assault of a minor) is toxic, which limits how far a meme can spread. Dozens of CLAV coins already exist.
narrative.why_spreading: The name is famous and in the news, and new CLAV clones keep launching. I found no new catalyst today.

token_connection.why_this_token: It has the most volume and liquidity in the current clone batch. It has no website or socials of its own. GeckoTerminal lists the handle 'clavicular', which is probably the influencer's own account.
token_connection.competing_tokens: C5bm (same name, liquidity now $0), HccK (same name, $38k market cap, and cited in this token's description), 8sqM looks/max, and many older CLAV pump.fun coins.

authenticity.evidence: Buyers massively outnumber sellers (2,046 unique buyers vs 36 unique sellers). Buyers arrived in one burst and dropped to 27 in the last 5 minutes. One wallet holds 80.57% of supply. The bot/degen share is 0.81. Serial clones with the same name keep appearing, and one has already gone to zero liquidity. There are no socials.
authenticity.uncertainty: I could not see X or on-chain transfer graphs. The 80% wallet could be some kind of pool or escrow account, but RugCheck does not label it as one.

structural_risks: A single unlabeled wallet holds 80.57% of supply against a $33k pool
100% of LP is unlocked and the LP providers are few
It was launched directly on PumpSwap with no curve, and a same-name sibling has already been drained
The spray-buy pattern suggests the volume is fake

structured_output.counterargument: Clavicular really is in the headlines and his name coins trade actively. This one leads its clone batch on volume, has renounced mint and freeze authority, and the creator holds 0%. If the 80% wallet is some kind of locked or pool account, speculative flow could double a $105k market cap within hours.
unknowns: Whether the C5bm and HccK clones share a deployer with this token

source_coverage.notes: The time budget was very short. A search for the contract address returned nothing, and DexScreener returned 403. News confirms the Clavicular rape charge from 2026-09-22. Many older CLAV coins exist on aggregators.

structured_output.thesis: A manufactured serial clone of a four-day-old, toxic news meme. The structure makes a rug by the 80% holder or an LP pull very likely. I rank it well below the typical coin in this pool.
